## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and I added or updated a test where behavior changed
- [ ] Any schedule or playback code reads time through `viewNow()`, not `Date.now()`
- [ ] No copyrighted media, logos, trademarked branding or real network schedules are added; fixtures use made-up names
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths or personal data
- [ ] If it changes what users see, I added a dated entry to the in-app What's New (`CHANGELOG` in `renderer/js/setup/settings.js`)
- [ ] If it affects flashing or flicker, I considered photosensitivity (see the README notice)
